question: In herpes simplex encephalitis, drugs used are, EXCEPT:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Herpes simplex encephalitis" -> "viral infection" -> "treated with antiviral drugs" -> "Acyclovir used for herpes viruses" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Herpes simplex encephalitis" -> "caused by herpes simplex virus" -> "Vidarabine historically used for herpes infections" -> 90%

CHAIN: "Herpes simplex encephalitis" -> "requires antiviral therapy" -> "Ganciclovir effective against cytomegalovirus, less so for herpes simplex virus" -> "unclear effectiveness for herpes simplex encephalitis" -> 70%
CHAIN: "Herpes simplex encephalitis" -> "caused by herpes simplex virus" -> "Amantadine targets influenza viruses" -> "not effective against herpes viruses" -> 99%
analysis: Amantadine is specifically used for influenza viruses and has no efficacy against herpes viruses, making it inappropriate for the treatment of herpes simplex encephalitis. The other listed drugs have some level of efficacy against herpes viruses, with Acyclovir being the standard treatment.
